create_scaled_silu_activation: create a ScaledSiLU activation module that applies SiLU with a fixed scale factor to input tensors
build_swiglu_layer: build a SwiGLU or ScaledSwiGLU linear layer with gated linear unit activation for transformer models
create_smooth_leaky_relu: create a SmoothLeakyReLU or ScaledSmoothLeakyReLU activation module with configurable negative slope for smooth rectification
build_gate_activation: build a GateActivation module that applies gating scalars to input tensors with SO(3) equivariant indexing
create_s2_activation: create an S2Activation or SeparableS2Activation module that applies SiLU activation on the S2 sphere grid using SO3 transforms
